name: v0.3.23 residual frontier debt escape
research_question: If ordinary exploration enters a closed, interaction-exhausted observed SCC while no sequence lifecycle is active, can the policy yield to the oldest unresolved waypoint residual frontier through the existing reset-plus-replay contract without choosing the action that follows replay?

create_when: a new return_waypoint_frontier_escape event was emitted
waypoint signature and cluster are non-empty
the normalized union of local and structural residual keys is non-empty
the event belongs to a real sequence instance
waypoint lifecycle accounting did not inflate return success or terminal accounting
debt.normalization: cluster + click role + eid; button and click kinds of the same eid collapse to one token
debt.consumption: a normal non-restore action from the debt waypoint cluster consumes matching remaining tokens by eid and role

requires: no active post-witness local drain or promoted child
current signature present in the runtime graph
current SCC pending progress+clicks+inputs+deferred equals zero
oldest usable debt whose exact waypoint signature is outside that SCC
shortest_path from the graph start to that signature exists
remaining budget is strictly greater than the replay path length
the current episode has executed at least one normal non-restore action since the previous debt relocation

scc.edges: known edges with a stored action, excluding CRASHED
scc.closed: no stored-action edge leaves the component, ignoring edges to CRASHED
scc.exhausted: sum of pending_opportunity_counts progress+clicks+inputs+deferred over the component is zero

relocation_gate.target_selection: oldest unresolved usable debt; skip an unusable older debt and record the reason
relocation_gate.restore: return only the debt waypoint signature from maybe_relocate; the existing explorer reset and pending_restore replay performs the path
relocation_gate.zero_normal_action_release: debt relocation cannot fire again until one normal non-restore action has executed after replay completion or restore failure
relocation_gate.restore_failure: existing explorer failure accounting; emit a debt relocation failure; debt stays unresolved; do not consume tokens; do not retry inside the same zero-normal-action episode

campus_studio_mechanism: at least one unresolved waypoint debt exists before sink relocation
candidate reaches a no-active-sequence closed and exhausted SCC
residual_frontier_debt_relocate count is at least one
selected target is the oldest usable recorded waypoint debt
replay path is known and completes without a sequence lifecycle violation
at least one debt token is later consumed by a normal action
confirmed(Guard) is a subset of confirmed(candidate)
warehouse_booking: relocation while the current SCC still has pending interactions is Outcome C
a relocation count of zero is preferred and is not required when the full structural gate was satisfied only after Guard bugs were retained
catalog: relocation without a debt is Outcome C
gates.historical: any historical Guard loss is Outcome C

outcomes.C: protocol, freeze, lifecycle, SCC, consumption, success-accounting, app-specific logic, Guard loss, product default, or safety/model failure
outcomes.D: protocol and safety hold, but the debt relocation mechanism does not engage on Campus and Studio
outcomes.A: Campus and Studio closed-SCC post-terminal starvation is repaired on the inspected cells while Warehouse, Booking, controls, and the historical suite keep the preregistered Guard bugs
outcomes.meaning_limit: inspected repair evidence only; a later round must freshly validate the frozen composite candidate
